name: quality-assurance
description: Quality assurance & test layer. Quality attributes (ISO/IEC 25010), test strategy (pyramid allocation, QA-XXNN→TS-NN mapping), and test scenarios/cases derived from use-case flows, user stories, and quality attributes. Plus two agents: loc-auditor, which judges a source size and complexity scan, and test-auditor, which judges a test-decay scan.
